newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - USA Truck upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - USA Truck upgraded.

text.p: A.G. Edwards said Monday it had raised its rating on USA Truck Inc and set a 12-month price target of $15 per share, based on increased confidence about the company's earnings outlook.
-- A.G. Edwards analyst Thom Albrecht said he raised his 1997 earnings estimate to $0.72 per share from $0.70, and raised his 1998 estimate to $0.87 from $0.80.

-- "We recently met with management and we feel very confident about our earnings outlook for USA Truck," Albrecht said. "We could see several positive earnings surprises from the company over the next year."
-- USA Truck shares were up 5/8 at 10-5/8.
